# Quilcast

> Quilcast is a small, open-source Farcaster client that runs in the browser at quilcast.com and talks straight to the Hypersnap network that Quilibrium runs. Reads go to a public Hypersnap node, writes are messages signed in the browser, and keys stay in the browser's own storage. It has no accounts of its own, no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

What it does: following and trending feeds, browsing any account's Following feed without signing in ("Browse as", /?as=<username>), threads, profiles, notifications, search, casting, replies, quotes, likes, recasts, follows and channel posts, with up to four photos, videos or GIFs per cast (a quoted cast takes one of the four). It also has Farcaster direct messages (farcaster.xyz direct casts, live), Spaces (live audio rooms), a multi-chain wallet (Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon), Farcaster and Base mini apps, translations, private mutes and blocks synced across devices, an anonymous mode that follows people on the device without an account, and a spam filter (Settings → Spam) that labels or hides casts by their score from spam.quilcast.com, a free public API where a self-hosted Laya model scores every new cast. You can sign in with an existing Farcaster recovery phrase or an external wallet, or create a new Farcaster account for about $0.20 of ETH on Optimism. For fun, profiles can get MySpace-style looks (backgrounds, fonts, a Top 8, a profile song), the whole app can be re-themed, a profile Winamp plays YouTube playlists in any classic skin, and Quorum mode lays Quilcast out like Quilibrium's Quorum app.

## Links

- [Open Quilcast](https://quilcast.com)
- [About Quilcast](https://quilcast.com/about)
- [Android APK (latest release)](https://github.com/backmeupplz/quilcast/releases/latest/download/quilcast.apk)
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/backmeupplz/quilcast)
- [Verify that quilcast.com serves exactly the code of a commit in the repo](https://github.com/backmeupplz/quilcast#verify-this-build): the build's hashes are at https://quilcast.com/build.json, and `node scripts/verify.mjs` checks them
- [Quilcast Notes, the blog](https://blog.quilcast.com)
- [What a Farcaster mini app can and can't do inside Quilcast](https://blog.quilcast.com/farcaster-mini-app-sandbox-quilcast/)
- [Cast actions](https://quilcast.com/actions): buttons in the ⋯ menu under every cast, which people add from an official list or by link
- [Build a cast action](https://quilcast.com/developers/cast-actions): a cast action is a Farcaster mini app with a `castShareUrl` (the share extension spec); Quilcast opens it with the cast in the query and in `context.location` (`cast_share`)
- [One-click cast actions](https://quilcast.com/developers/cast-actions#one-click): a mini app adds ⋯ menu entries with `miniAppHost.addCastAction({ name, url, placeholder })` (the person confirms); a tap POSTs a JSON Farcaster Signature `{ type: 'cast_action', url, cast, input, notificationDetails, timestamp }` to `url` and shows the `{ message }` reply as a toast; any Hypersnap client can implement it
- [Composer actions](https://quilcast.com/composer-actions): mini apps people open from the composer's apps button to fill in the post they're writing, added from an official list or by link
- [Build a composer action](https://quilcast.com/developers/composer-actions): a composer action is a Farcaster mini app with a `composerActionUrl` in its manifest (a Quilcast addition); Quilcast opens it with `context.location` `{ type: 'composer', draft: { text, embeds, parent, quote, channelKey } }`, and the app's `sdk.actions.composeCast({ text, embeds })` fills the post (text replaces, embeds are added) and closes it; any Hypersnap client can implement it
- [Inline mini app embeds](https://quilcast.com/developers/inline-embeds): a mini app embed page adds `<meta name="fc:miniapp:inline" content='{"url","height"}'>` (url https on the app's origin, height 80-480 CSS px); clients run that page in the cast card in place of the picture, with `context.client.inline: true` and `location` `cast_embed`, answering only `ready`, `signIn` (host-drawn consent), `openUrl`, `openMiniApp`, `viewCast`, `viewProfile` (the client always asks in the card first), `getCapabilities`, `getChains` (empty); never on the client's own origin; Quilcast's Poll uses it to vote in the feed; any client can implement it
- [Inline stickers](https://quilcast.com/developers/stickers): a sticker in a cast's Markdown text is a picture of a sticker address, `![alt](https://quilcast.com/st/<pack 8 chars>/<24 hex>.webp)`, drawn in the line like an emoji (about 1.75em, animated WebP playing), not also sent as an embed, and read as its alt text (the sticker's emoji) in plain text
- [Build mini apps for Hypersnap](https://quilcast.com/developers/mini-apps): sign-in and notification webhook checks that work for accounts created on Hypersnap (FID 2^32 and up) by reading `/v1/signersByFid` and custody from a Hypersnap node, with Snapchain as an optional fallback; Quilcast signs webhook events with the account's gasless signer and falls back to an on-chain app key when a webhook answers 401
- [Privacy policy](https://quilcast.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://quilcast.com/terms)
- [Safety](https://quilcast.com/safety)
